name: VSN Eurofighter Typhoon
summary: VSN team's free Eurofighter Typhoon for DCS World using FC3-style avionics.
description:
Free VSN mod adding the Eurofighter Typhoon with a custom exterior model (based on purchased Turbosquid data) and FC3-style cockpit. Flyable with the FC3 (F-15C/Su-27-style) cockpit, or as AI without FC3.

VSN's downloads are on pCloud and ask for a password; VSN publishes it on their download index: `VSNROX`.

Requires: Flyable only with Flaming Cliffs 3 installed; otherwise usable as AI.
license: Free, private use only, commercial use prohibited (VSN terms)
